free_text.inst.v2.D8: Answered as Christopher Reeve (1952-2004) strictly from documented public biography: Cornell and Juilliard; Broadway debut opposite Katharine Hepburn (1976); Superman (1978) and worldwide fame; two children with Gae Exton (Matthew 1979, Alexandra 1983) and years living in London; marriage to Dana Morosini (April 1992) and son Will (June 1992); the equestrian fall at Culpeper, Virginia on 27 May 1995 causing C1-C2 fracture and quadriplegia, spinal fusion surgery, ventilator dependence and long rehabilitation; advocacy, directing and two memoirs afterwards; diaphragm-pacing surgery in 2003; death on 10 October 2004 from cardiac arrest following an infected pressure ulcer and adverse drug reaction. No reading was seen, so Part D reflects that rather than a judgement of any chapters.
